parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.question_text: State the name of this type of nuclear reaction.
parts.question_text_latex: State the name of this type of nuclear reaction.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.question_text:
Show that the energy released when one nucleus of helium-4 is formed from deuterium
is 3.47 × 10^{-12} J.
parts.question_text_latex:
Show that the energy released when one nucleus of helium-4 is formed from deuterium
is $3.47 \times 10^{-12}\,\mathrm{J}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
A star has a radius of 6.96 × 10^{8} m. Helium-4 is produced in this star, from deuterium, at a
mass rate of 7.34 × 10^{11} kg s^{-1}. All the energy released from this process is radiated away
from the star. All the energy that is radiated from the star is released by this process.
parts.question_text_latex:
A star has a radius of $6.96 \times 10^{8}\,\mathrm{m}$. Helium-4 is produced in this star, from deuterium, at a
mass rate of $7.34 \times 10^{11}\,\mathrm{kg}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$. All the energy released from this process is radiated away
from the star. All the energy that is radiated from the star is released by this process.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the luminosity of the star.
luminosity = W
parts.question_text_latex:
Calculate the luminosity of the star.
$luminosity = W $

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text:
Use your answer in (b)(i) to determine the surface temperature of the star.
temperature = K
parts.question_text_latex:
Use your answer in (b)(i) to determine the surface temperature of the star.
